newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa catering plans listing H2 1998.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa catering plans listing H2 1998.

text.p: Lufthansa Service Holding AG, the catering division of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, is planning to seek a bourse listing in the second half of 1998, but Lufthansa will retain a majority, LSG's chief financial officer Marc Bamberger said.
Bamberger said on the fringes of an LSG news conference that it was not yet clear whether a capital rise would accompany the listing or not.
But LSG management board chairman Helmut Woelki told the news conference: "Lufthansa will retain its majority initially."
Bamberger said the proposed listing date meant LSG would hit the market after Sky Chefs Inc, which is set to list in the United States next year.
Further details of the listing of the Onex Corp-held group had not been announced, he said.

Woekl said LSG planned to improve on 1996's record result in the current business year, adding the group hoped for earnings of 72 million marks ($40.5 million), up from 70.8 million. Sales were also set to rise slightly from 2.234 billion in 1996.
